description.text:
Obsidian (黎) is one of the two booster packs of Sword & Shield: Vivid Portrayals (浓墨重彩), the second Sword & Shield booster release in Simplified Chinese, on sale from 18 August 2023 alongside Indigo (靛). Vivid Portrayals brought Amazing Rare (A) cards to the Simplified Chinese game for the first time: Legendary and Mythical Pokémon with special art and finish, whose attacks need Energy of several types. Packs held 5 or 25 cards.

Obsidian holds the Grass, Fire, Fighting and Metal Pokémon and the Trainers that go with them. Charizard VMAX is on its cover, and its Amazing Rares are Reshiram, Zamazenta and Rayquaza. Its other VMAX cards are Orbeetle, Coalossal, Scizor and Salamence VMAX, and it has Decidueye, whose Ability keeps it from taking damage from Pokémon V and Pokémon-GX attacks. Its main cards are numbered out of 115; shiny, full-art, shiny full-art, rainbow and gold cards run to 143. The Charizard VMAX Battle and Collection gift boxes released the same day each held a Charizard VMAX with the rainbow (HR) finish, the Collection box's with special art.
